request.prompt: Huge heavy barbarian brute with short legs, wide stance, feet planted far apart, knees slightly bent, weight low. Right hand grips a heavy chain hook steady at the right hip; left hand rests near the belly. Slow deep breathing: chest, shoulders and head rise and fall together, tiny weight shift side to side. No stepping, no arm swinging. Seamless loop ending in the start pose.

Huge heavy barbarian with short legs walking forward at a steady pace with wide rolling steps, feet landing well apart, body swaying side to side to carry a heavy chain. Torso upright and steady, chest proud. Right hand holds a chain hook close at the right hip without swinging it; left arm swings a little. Constant speed, cyclic walk loop.

Huge heavy barbarian with short legs running forward, torso leaning forward, short powerful wide strides, heavy pounding footfalls. Right hand pulls a heavy chain hook tight against the right side of the body; left arm pumps. Shoulders roll with the weight. Constant speed, cyclic run loop.

Huge barbarian in a wide planted stance, right hand grips a heavy chain hook, left hand holds the chain near the belly. Small crouch, twist torso right and raise the hook high back over the right shoulder, brief hold, then swing it forward and down to smash the ground in front with full body weight, hips and shoulders turning. Absorb the recoil, pull the chain back hand over hand, back to stance.

Huge barbarian, feet planted wide. Right hand holds a heavy chain hook. Wind up: twist the torso right and swing the hook back low behind the right hip. Then uncoil and throw it straight forward, right arm fully extended, left arm back, chest facing forward. Hold the arm out a moment, then both hands yank the chain back hand over hand toward the chest in strong pulls. Return to stance.

Huge barbarian with short legs crouches, swings a heavy chain hook up high over the head with both hands, small heavy hop, lands and slams it straight down onto the ground in front with full body weight, knees bending deep on impact, shoulders hunched. Brief pause, then rises back into a wide ready stance holding the chain at the right hip.

Huge barbarian lunges forward low and grabs an enemy by the collar with the left hand, holds him, and beats him with a heavy chain hook in the right hand: a vertical overhead blow, a low swing left to right, another overhead blow, a low swing right to left, then a final huge overhead smash to the ground with the whole body. Quickly recovers to a wide stance.
